Delhi Traffic Disruptions Expected Due to Weddings and Events

Traffic disruptions were anticipated in South, Central, and North Delhi on November 23 due to over 19 weddings and an expected influx of 3,500 additional vehicles. Restrictions and diversions were planned for affected routes.
